description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + empty command log. Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.6.0 regenerated every hash because Milestone 8 extended the canonical stream with the species registry, the world event log and the event-detector state, and because the initial world now carries a founder species record and a WorldCreated event. The organisms' trajectory is UNCHANGED from 0.5.0 — phases 16 and 17 observe the world and write registry/event state; they never touch an organism, a plant or the PRNG — and the tick-10000 population, generation and diet statistics reproduce 0.5.0's exactly.
